prompt: Create one complete, realistic, isolated rug as a regular household product. Visible geometry and style: 弧形边缘，呈圆形局部可见; 简约北欧风. Use materials ['编织织物'] and colors ['浅米色']. Preserve ['浅米色与横向编织纹理']. Regularize temporary disorder with ['展平边缘，整理为完整圆形']. Simplify modeling complexity with ['简化细密编织纹理层次']: use clean broad surfaces, shallow orderly folds, separated non-intersecting parts, and avoid tangled fabric or dense tiny wrinkles. Complete occluded, back, side and underside regions using {'type': 'axial', 'completionRule': '按圆形对称补全整体轮廓'} and ['补全被遮挡的圆形其余部分']. Texture rule: 横向条纹编织纹理; 延续横向条纹环绕圆形. Target plausible real-world dimensions are approximately 1.30 m wide, 1.30 m deep and 0.02 m high. Preserve the corresponding width-to-depth-to-height proportions. These are category-prior estimates rather than pixel measurements. Use conservative category structure, repeated modules, continuous closed geometry, and one 45-degree product view on a plain light background. Keep only the main object.
